assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
The Holter monitor is coded with CPT 93226.
The associated diagnoses are R55, I48.91, and I49.9.
The denial code CO-22 references coordination of benefits.
The medical necessity of the Holter study remains independent of payer sequencing.
The service was properly authorized pending verification.
